DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSE TO INTERROGATORIES, REQUESTS FOR ADMISSIONS, REQUESTS FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, AND FOR CONTINUED DEPOSITION OF CHERYL BROOKS IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. AS TO THE DEPOSITION OF CHERYL BROOKS, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HAS NOT BEEN SERVED UPON THE DEPONENT. THE DETERMINATION OF THE ADMISSIBILITY OF HER DEPOSITION AT TRIAL IS RESERVED TO THE TRIAL JUDGE BASED UPON A DETERMINATION OF WHETHER HER DEPOSITION HAS BEEN COMPLETED. AS TO ANY WRITTEN DISCOVERY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS MOTION, FURTHER RESPONSES SHALL BE MADE BY INVOKING THE FIFTH AMENDMENT OR FURTHER RESPONSE. DOCUMENTS, WITNESSES, OR FACTS NOT PROVIDED WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER SHALL BE BARRED FROM ADMISSION INTO EVIDENCE AT TRIAL. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
